command:example.maml:title: EXAMPLE 1
command:example.dev:code: New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile -Side Left -IconKind Computer -SurfaceStyle Raised -Label HOSTNAME -Value '{{HostName}}' -Detail 'production desktop' -Accent '#0F766EFF'

command:example.maml:title: EXAMPLE 2
command:example.dev:code: New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile -Side Right -IconKind Cpu -SurfaceStyle Raised -Label 'CPU LOAD' -Value '31% active' -MiniChartKind Area -MiniChartValues 22,28,25,36,31 -MiniChartMaximum 100
